topic: Knesset elects Matan Kahana as speaker

en.headline: Knesset advances bills to repeal judicial overhaul laws
en.body: The Knesset is advancing legislation to repeal laws associated with Benjamin Netanyahu’s judicial overhaul, according to The Jerusalem Post and South China Morning Post. The legislative push follows the election of a new speaker from the anti-Netanyahu bloc.

fr.headline: La Knesset fait avancer des projets de loi visant à abroger la réforme judiciaire
fr.body: La Knesset fait progresser une législation visant à abroger les lois associées à la réforme judiciaire de Benjamin Netanyahu, selon le Jerusalem Post et le South China Morning Post. Cette offensive législative fait suite à l'élection d'un nouveau président issu du bloc anti-Netanyahu.

de.headline: Knesset bringt Gesetze zur Aufhebung der Justizreform voran
de.body: Die Knesset bringt laut der „Jerusalem Post“ und der „South China Morning Post“ Gesetzesvorhaben zur Aufhebung von Gesetzen im Zusammenhang mit Benjamin Netanjahus Justizreform voran. Der gesetzgeberische Vorstoß folgt auf die Wahl eines neuen Präsidenten des Repräsentantenhauses aus dem Anti-Netanjahu-Lager.

pt.headline: Knesset avança com projetos de lei para revogar legislação da reforma judicial
pt.body: O Knesset está a avançar com legislação para revogar leis associadas à reforma judicial de Benjamin Netanyahu, segundo o The Jerusalem Post e o South China Morning Post. O impulso legislativo surge após a eleição de um novo presidente do parlamento oriundo do bloco anti-Netanyahu.

it.headline: La Knesset promuove disegni di legge per abrogare le norme sulla riforma giudiziaria
it.body: La Knesset sta portando avanti una legislazione per abrogare le leggi associate alla riforma giudiziaria di Benjamin Netanyahu, secondo quanto riportato dal Jerusalem Post e dal South China Morning Post. L'iniziativa legislativa segue l'elezione di un nuovo presidente dell'assemblea proveniente dal blocco anti-Netanyahu.

ko.headline: 이스라엘 크네세트, 사법 개혁 관련 법안 폐지 절차 착수
ko.body: 예루살렘 포스트와 사우스 차이나 모닝 포스트에 따르면, 이스라엘 크네세트(의회)는 베냐민 네타냐후 총리의 사법 개혁과 관련된 법안들을 폐지하기 위한 입법 절차를 진행 중이다. 이번 입법 추진은 반(反)네타냐후 진영에서 새로운 의장이 선출된 이후 이루어졌다.

es.headline: La Knéset impulsa proyectos de ley para derogar las normas de la reforma judicial
es.body: La Knéset está impulsando legislación para derogar las leyes asociadas a la reforma judicial de Benjamin Netanyahu, según The Jerusalem Post y el South China Morning Post. El impulso legislativo se produce tras la elección de un nuevo presidente de la cámara perteneciente al bloque contrario a Netanyahu.

zh.headline: 以色列议会推进废除司法改革相关法律的法案
zh.body: 据《耶路撒冷邮报》和《南华早报》报道，以色列议会正在推进废除与本雅明·内塔尼亚胡司法改革相关法律的立法工作。此次立法行动是在反内塔尼亚胡阵营选出新议长后进行的。

ja.headline: イスラエル議会、司法改革関連法の撤廃法案を推進
ja.body: エルサレム・ポストおよびサウスチャイナ・モーニング・ポストによると、イスラエル議会（クネセト）は、ベンヤミン・ネタニヤフ首相が進めた司法改革に関連する法律を撤廃するための法案を推進している。この動きは、反ネタニヤフ派から新たな議長が選出されたことを受けてのもの。

en.headline: Knesset elects Matan Kahana speaker by 66-52 vote
en.body: The Jerusalem Post reported Kahana was elected speaker with a vote of 66-52, and The Times of Israel stated the vote followed a six-hour filibuster by the Netanyahu bloc.

de.headline: Knesset wählt Matan Kahana zum Sprecher mit 66-52 Stimmen
de.body: Die Jerusalem Post berichtete, Kahana mit 66-52 Stimmen gewählt worden zu sein, und The Times of Israel gab an, dass die Abstimmung auf einen sechsstündigen Filibuster des Netanyahu-Blocks folgte.

es.headline: Knesset elige a Matan Kahana como orador con un voto de 66-52
es.body: The Jerusalem Post informó que Kahana fue elegido orador con un voto de 66-52, y The Times of Israel señaló que el voto siguió a un filibustero de seis horas por parte del bloque de Netanyahu.

fr.headline: La Knesset élit Matan Kahana à la présidence par 66 voix contre 52
fr.body: Le Jerusalem Post a rapporté que Kahana a été élu président avec un vote de 66-52, et The Times of Israel a indiqué que ce vote faisait suite à un filibuster de six heures par le bloc Netanyahu.

it.headline: La Knesset elegge Matan Kahana presidente con un voto di 66-52
it.body: Il Jerusalem Post ha riportato che Kahana è stato eletto presidente con un voto di 66-52, e The Times of Israel ha dichiarato che il voto è seguito da un filibustero di sei ore del blocco Netanyahu.

ko.headline: 네타냐후 진영의 6시간 필리버스터 끝에 네타냐후 진영 후보 마탄 카하나, 의회 의장 선출
ko.body: 예루살렘 포스트는 카하나가 66-52의 투표로 의장에 선출됐다고 보도했고, 타임스 오브 이스라엘은 네타냐호 블록의 6시간 필리버스터 후 투표가 진행됐다고 전했다.

zh.headline: 以色列议会以66票对52票选举马坦·卡哈纳为议会发言人
zh.body: 《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，卡哈纳以66票对52票当选发言人；《以色列时报》指出，该投票是在内塔尼亚胡阵营进行六小时的阻挠议事后进行的。

pt.headline: Knesset elege Matan Kahana porta-voz por voto de 66-52
pt.body: O Jerusalem Post reportou que Kahana foi eleito porta-voz com um voto de 66-52, e o The Times of Israel afirmou que o voto se seguiu a um filibustagem de seis horas pelo bloco de Netanyahu.

ja.headline: クネセト、マタン・カハナを66対52の票差で議長に選出
ja.body: ジェルーサレム・ポスト紙は、カハナが66対52の票で議長に選出されたと報じ、タイムズ・オブ・イスラエル紙は、この投票はネタニヤフ派による6時間にわたるフィリバスターに続いたと伝えた。

en.title: Knesset elects Matan Kahana speaker by 66-52 vote
en.dek: Kahana elected speaker after six-hour filibuster as anti-Netanyahu bloc takes control
facts: Knesset elected Matan Kahana speaker with 66-52 vote
Vote followed six-hour filibuster by Netanyahu bloc
Legislation advancing to repeal judicial overhaul laws
Eisenkot-led bloc celebrates election as step toward broad change
body: The Knesset elected Matan Kahana as speaker with a vote of 66-52 on Tuesday, according to The Jerusalem Post and The Times of Israel.
The vote followed a six-hour filibuster by the Netanyahu bloc, which attempted to block the election, the same sources reported.
The legislative push to repeal laws associated with Benjamin Netanyahu’s judicial overhaul is now advancing, according to The Jerusalem Post and South China Morning Post.
The repeal effort follows the election of a new speaker from the anti-Netanyahu bloc, sources said.
The Eisenkot-led bloc celebrated Kahana's election as a step toward broad change, according to The Jerusalem Post.
Kahana, representing the Yashar party, secured the speaker position after the extended debate period.
The developments mark a shift in Knesset leadership following the recent electoral cycle.
en.context: The Knesset vote for a new speaker occurred after a prolonged filibuster attempt by the Netanyahu bloc, with Matan Kahana emerging as the successful candidate from the opposition camp. The legislative agenda is now shifting toward repealing judicial overhaul laws passed during the previous government.
